scope: Read-only static review; no QEMU, public component tests, native run, or new remote capture performed by this review.
model_findings: The always-present SysBus instance applies enabled-reference after global properties in realize; disabled MemoryRegions preserve existing unassigned SBM holes.
CLR/SET/SENSE use only three isolated four-byte windows. Unsupported masks and invalid command directions cannot update state or diagnostics.
Each port has independent requested/sense/pending state. Duplicate requests preserve their interval and reversing to current sense cancels outstanding work.
Only the virtual timer commits sense. Reads and host stall changes do not acknowledge due requests, including a paused or stalled zero remainder.
Multi-bit request and unstall overflow is prevalidated before any port or diagnostic mutation.
System reset clears request/sense/pending, local deadlines and accepted counters, while retaining the explicitly external stall input.
The 152-byte VMState prefix binds profile and geometry; runtime validation rejects unsupported masks, inconsistent pending, invalid remaining phases and impossible zero-count histories.

Pre-save samples a single virtual now without dispatch. Pre-load disables the timer. Post-load checks all active additions before rebasing remaining phases to the target virtual origin and scheduling the earliest timer.
The runtime has no Clock, IRQ or DMA coupling; the document accurately limits feedback to an explicit reference peer, not physical NoC drain.
remaining_gates: The new component test and exact formal CI artifact still need actual execution.
Native progress, accepted requests and timeout log evidence must be assessed separately; an idempotent CLR is not a delayed transition or drain witness.
